children: BOOSTER Precision Components Holding GmbH postponed interest and principal payments on its 2022/2026 bond, both due November 28, 2026, to preserve liquidity and implement a restructuring concept agreed with bondholders. The standstill was extended to December 28, 2026.
The issuer is not making bond payments when due, signaling immediate liquidity pressure.
Bondholders agreed not to enforce the bond during the extension, providing time for restructuring negotiations.
The postponed obligations were due shortly after the announcement; no revised payment date was stated.

This is a significant restructuring development amid ongoing capital-structure negotiations under StaRUG, not a routine payment update. Further details on the restructuring concept and amended bond terms would determine whether the standstill leads to a durable agreement.
